title: Step at a choice instruction
statement: Let $A$ be a nondeterministic register machine, let $\text{oracle}$ be an oracle, let $x$ be an input bit string, and suppose the instruction at control state $l$ chooses between states $l_1$ and $l_0$. For any Boolean choice $b$, register assignment $v$, and optional Boolean result $r$, one step from the configuration with control state $l$, register assignment $v$, and result $r$ moves to $l_1$ if $b$ is true and to $l_0$ if $b$ is false, leaving the registers and result unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: An oracle and input bit string
The instruction at $l$ is a choice between $l_1$ and $l_0$
